headline: Committee weighs lobbyist rules, recesses before voting

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.summary: The committee reviewed Bill 100 on lobbyist rules, discussed a $5,000 penalty, and went into recess before any vote.
meeting.recap: The main item was Bill 100 (2026), which would set rules for lobbyists, including registration, reporting and penalties.[[0:09:27]] She said a penalty of up to $5,000 per violation was replaced with a reference to another section that Bill 55 would cap at $1,000.[[0:14:30]] The Board of Ethics prefers a penalty of up to $5,000, matching the state's penalty for lobbyist violations.[[0:15:00]] A deputy corporation counsel (a county attorney) said a penalty of up to $5,000 would be allowed under the charter.[[0:30:20]] The director said lobbyists would file expenditure reports twice a year, compared with four times a year for the state.[[0:37:30]] A council member said the rules would take effect July 1, 2027, and the director agreed.[[0:41:44]] Members asked if people lobbying the Planning Commission would have to register, and one attorney disagreed with the others.[[1:05:54]] A motion was made and seconded to recommend passing Bill 100 on first reading.[[1:26:30]] A second motion was made and seconded to replace the bill with a revised version called CD1.[[1:26:49]] The recording ends during the recess, before any vote.[[1:29:49]]
decided: The motion was made and seconded, but no vote was taken before the recess in this recording.

meeting.next: The chair planned a recess so the attorneys could discuss possible amendments before the committee took them up.
